mission.name: The Horde Awakens (Orc 1/3)
mission.briefing: The warchief wakes. The humans built a tower-hall on our hunting grounds. Level it, and let the Horde breathe again.
mission.objective: Burn the human outpost in the north-east.

ops.text: Warchief: that human hall poisons the land. Put it to the torch.
Burn the human outpost in the north-east.
Your keep has fallen. The campaign is lost.
The enemy encampment is razed. Victory!
Enemy reinforcements sighted on the road!
